mentions.name: Kavla
mentions.description: An open source SQL canvas that adds interactivity to queries: typing {var} in a query pops out a "knob" widget that infers the column's type and values, e.g. turning `SELECT * FROM hn_posts WHERE score>{score}` into a slider from 0 to 6015. A browser-based Titanic demo runs entirely in WASM without login.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on Kavla, my open source SQL canvas https://github.com/aleda145/kavla

I'm very excited by adding interactivity. I have a new "knob" feature that pops out when you type {var}. It infers the column's type and values.

`SELECT * FROM hn_posts WHERE score>{score}` will grant you a slider that goes from 0 to 6015

Titanic Browser demo (no login, it's all WASM): https://app.kavla.dev/

mentions.name: kavla
mentions.description: An open-source SQL canvas for exploring and querying data visually, with a website and a login-free demo. The cloud version uses a Kimi 2.7-based analytics agent, and the self-hosted local version is planned to get its own agent plus a fully local LLM setup so sensitive data can stay on-device.
mentions.problem: Analyzing data without it leaving the user's device, motivating a fully local LLM setup for sensitive data.
